//AllowedHosts: Deliberately *: the framework's filter sits at the front of the pipeline and cannot exempt a path, and platform health probes (Azure Container Apps, Kubernetes) address the container by pod IP, a name nobody can list in advance; a filter that cannot exempt them risks a revision that never turns ready. HostAllowlist below does the filtering, with the health route exempt (server/Api/HostAllowlist.cs).
//HostAllowlist: Comma-separated host names; *.example.io matches any subdomain. Empty means no filtering in Development and REFUSES TO START anywhere else: set HostAllowlist__Hosts.
